note: What a server sends to have a slot's targeting work from another unit. The header names the unit.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot. A champion's own spells count from 0.

bits.name: summonerSlots
bits.note: Set where slot names a summoner spell's slot, clear for the unit's own spells; every kind obeys it.

fields.name: offsetFrom
fields.note: The unit the slot's targeting indicator works from instead of the caster, while the client holds it; one it does not hold resets this to none.
